description: NaCr(PS₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.11 Å. Cr is bonded to six S atoms to form CrS₆ octahedra that share corners with six PPS₃ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CrS₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-S bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.45 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to one P and three S atoms to form distorted PPS₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 73-75°. The P-P bond length is 2.22 Å. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.13 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to one P and three S atoms to form distorted PPS₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 73-74°. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.14 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Cr and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Cr and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Cr and one P atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
